prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original FRAME ACADEMY Light & Shadow course cover, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: A dramatic still life of an off-white plaster sphere and folded textured fabric casting directional shadow on a charcoal studio table. An objective and tactile study of light.
Composition/framing: Landscape medium view; sphere near the right third, folded ivory textured linen toward the left and lower center. Strong clean shadow shapes give the composition structure; believable physical scale.
Lighting/mood: warm shaft of light from one tall window outside frame, sharp but physically credible shadow edge, rest of room falls into rich charcoal darkness.
Materials/textures: powdery plaster, visible woven fibers, fine irregularities, matte table surface, analog photographic texture.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted warm gray, charcoal black.
Constraints: no words, lettering, logos, watermark or UI; no extra decorative objects; not a 3D render. Produce one finished original photograph.
